description: Displays the active cell reference and provides an input for editing cell values and formulas. The fx mark is a permanent part of the bar, the name box offers the workbook's named ranges, and while the bar is editing it exposes the ✓ commit and ✗ revert buttons with localized accessible names. Synchronizes bidirectionally with the active cell in the spreadsheet grid.

parameters.name: ActiveCellRef
parameters.description: The A1 reference of the currently active cell.

parameters.name: DisplayValue
parameters.description: The current display value or formula of the active cell.

parameters.name: IsEditing
parameters.description: Whether the formula bar is in editing mode.

parameters.name: OnCommitNavigationRequested
parameters.description: Called after a commit when spreadsheet-like navigation should move the active cell.

parameters.name: OnEditCancelled
parameters.description: Called when the user cancels editing in the formula bar.

parameters.name: OnEditStarted
parameters.description: Called when the user starts editing in the formula bar.

parameters.name: OnNavigateToRef
parameters.description: Called when the user enters a cell reference or named range in the name box and presses Enter.

parameters.name: OnTabPressed
parameters.description: Called when the user presses Tab while editing in the formula bar.

parameters.name: OnTransferToInlineEditorRequested
parameters.description: Called when the current formula session should move into the inline grid editor.

parameters.name: OnValueChanged
parameters.description: Called when the formula bar value changes during editing.

parameters.name: OnValueCommitted
parameters.description: Called when the user commits a value from the formula bar.

parameters.name: NamedRanges
parameters.description: The workbook's named ranges, offered as a dropdown list next to the name box. When the list is empty the chevron is not rendered and the name box stays the plain A1 input; selecting an entry raises OnNavigateToRef with the range name.
